run_coverage_report_server: run the symcov coverage report HTTP server on a specified host and port with a given symcov file
build_symcov_data: build a SymcovData object from symcov JSON containing covered points and point-symbol info
compute_file_coverage: compute per-file coverage percentage from covered points and point-symbol information
compute_linemap: compute a line-number to CSS class map for highlighting covered, not-covered, and partially-covered lines
format_coverage_pct: format a coverage percentage as an HTML string with leading zeros styled as lightgray
